identity: A lanky set of robotic limbs armed with surgical devices and construction tools.  The arms protrude from a barrel-like base, mounted upon small casters.  Even when idle, it moves like an insect grooming its antennae.  The scalpel is stropped against another arm.  The over-articulated grasper picks at the other tools.  The circular saw silently rotates, as if it were itself scanning the surroundings.  Embedded in the side of the device is a bulbous computer terminal, displaying several options, from standard medical services to advanced bionic surgery.
